fusions.name: Grip and Pin
fusions.desc: Closes up to 5 tiles onto the target and runs it through, dealing 13 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Palm Never Shakes
fusions.desc: Throws with a hand that does not shake, dealing 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Choke Up
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Grip Tightens Late
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies at low health.
